mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and may compete for CYP450 enzymes; chloroquine can increase praziquantel levels while praziquantel may alter chloroquine metabolism, with potential additive CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased praziquantel adverse effects (dizziness, headache, abdominal discomfort) and chloroquine toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring or dose adjustment if toxicity emerges.
